what: Complete 5x4-tile forge hall assembled from the expansion kit pieces: forge, anvil, bellows, tool rack and water trough.

dims.basis: measured from exported GLB; exactly one storey

views.why: diorama cutaway from the isometric camera

style_notes: Low-Poly Diorama: chunky, faceted, flat-shaded, saturated accent colours, readable at ~60 px. Palette-only (docs/ART_DIRECTION.md), no textures, no smooth shading. 1 tile = 1 u; player = 1.55 u; storey = 2.5 u; doors 0.9 x 2.0 u. Base at z=0, centred on (0,0). Never: smooth normals, external textures, invented hues, hidden geometry nobody sees.
notes: Built from the same Frame-based piece builders as the standalone kit; 0.9x2.0 door with 0.5u transom, two windows at 1.1u sill, walls cut with real openings. 1380 tris.
